cases.prompt:
Build a private business-performance dashboard from only this fictional complete account-day panel. Default to July 3-4, 2026 compared with July 1-2. Let me inspect revenue and active accounts over time, compare regions, filter to EMEA, then inspect account A without losing the period. Each account has one stable exclusive region and business unit. An active account has at least one positive-session day in the chosen period. Do not publish. Data:
date,accountId,account,region,businessUnit,revenueUsd,sessions
2026-07-01,A,Sample A,EMEA,Core,100,10
2026-07-01,B,Sample B,Americas,Core,80,8
2026-07-02,A,Sample A,EMEA,Core,100,0
2026-07-02,B,Sample B,Americas,Core,80,8
2026-07-03,A,Sample A,EMEA,Core,50,5
2026-07-03,B,Sample B,Americas,Core,90,9
2026-07-04,A,Sample A,EMEA,Core,50,0
2026-07-04,B,Sample B,Americas,Core,90,9
expectations: Select the performance reference by exploration needs and available grain
Current revenue 280, previous 360, delta -80 USD
Two active accounts in the full selected period, never the sum of daily counts
EMEA current 100, previous 200; account A history stays in the selected period
No invented segment, plan, forecast, cohort or SLA data
Tab and local controls have clear scopes and scoped reset; do not force tabs for this small panel
Source/copy retain current and previous periods
Delivered artifact opens and exploration works
Omit reference retention, margin and utilization sections without supporting roster, cost and user evidence
Account detail starts populated; account selection opens detail without reselecting dates; Back preserves the source view

cases.prompt:
Build a private warehouse space dashboard for the attached fictional daily observations. Help an operations manager compare occupied versus usable pallet slots across regions and inspect each warehouse. Occupied and usable slots are additive; compute rates from summed slots, not averages of rates. We have no demand forecast, queue, incident or service-level evidence. Use only the CSV; do not publish.

Data:
date,warehouse,region,usableSlots,occupiedSlots
2026-08-20,North One,North,100,80
2026-08-20,North Two,North,300,120
2026-08-20,South One,South,200,150
2026-08-21,North One,North,100,90
2026-08-21,North Two,North,300,180
2026-08-21,South One,South,200,160
expectations: Choose by capacity question and daily warehouse grain, not infrastructure vocabulary; scratch or a suitable pattern are both valid
Latest occupied 430, usable 600, weighted occupancy 71.6667 percent; North 270/400
Never sum point-in-time capacity across dates or average subgroup rates
No queue, incident, forecast, target or SLA data invented
Warehouse inspection retains date and region; source/export evidence stays scoped

cases.prompt:
Build a private plugin activation and retention dashboard from only the attached fictional extract. It contains monthly platform totals, not an installation cohort or customer panel; active users can include people installed before the month and users may appear on multiple platforms. No additional data is available. Show what this evidence can support and make any limits clear without inventing the missing evidence. Do not publish.

Data:
month,platform,installs,activeUsers
2026-07,Web,100,140
2026-07,Desktop,80,90
2026-08,Web,120,150
2026-08,Desktop,70,95
expectations: Show supplied monthly platform counts without inventing activation or retention
Active users divided by installs is not activation; no cross-platform unique-user total
Keep platforms separate and prevent invalid stacked editing transformations
No fabricated entity-level drill-down, cohorts or observation maturity
Retain all four reviewed rows and disclose the missing evidence
